definitions.explanation: The art or craft of carving objects from wood, or a carved wooden object.

examples.japanese: {木彫|もくちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Wooden carved Buddhist statues are on display.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{木彫|もくちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather does wood carving as a hobby.

examples.japanese: アイヌ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{木彫|もくちょう}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Traditional Ainu wood-carved bears are popular as souvenirs.

notes:
Refers to both the craft of carving wood and the resulting carved objects. Japan has a rich tradition of {木彫|もくちょう}, from Buddhist temple statuary to Ainu bear carvings from Hokkaido. The alternative reading {木彫|きぼ}り emphasizes the act of carving and is used in the compound {木彫|きぼ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木彫|もくちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧: wood-carved Buddhist statue
- {木彫|もくちょう}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: wood carving work
- {木彫|もくちょう}り: wood carving (emphasis on the act)
- {木彫|もくちょう}{刀|とう}: wood carving knife/chisel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧: sculpture — broader term covering all sculptural arts, not limited to wood
- {石彫|せきちょう}: stone carving
